opening-reveal-2200: Human Within. A quieter world begins within.
opening-welcome-500: Welcome to Human Within. For the next little while, nothing needs to be solved. Just let this moment be here.
opening-settle-0: Let your hands soften. If it feels comfortable, let your shoulders settle.
opening-settle-14500: Notice where your body meets the chair, the bed, or the ground.
opening-follow-0: Rest your eyes wherever they feel comfortable. Follow the little light, or let your gaze be still.
opening-follow-16000: Let your breathing find its own pace. No counting. No holding. Simply notice one breath.
opening-notice-0: Notice one ordinary thing around you. A colour. A texture. A quiet sound.
opening-notice-15500: You do not need to make this moment feel any particular way. Let it be as it is.
opening-return-0: You can carry this pace with you. A little more room. A little less rush. Welcome inside.
